mast

layout · 0.1.2 · A4 · aj-l-mast

The masthead: the wordmark and the second-row object (the date box or the zoom control). The same height on every destination, so nothing below it moves when you switch (rule 7.6, revision 17). A row at the top of the page at 390 and 834; at 1440 its title form is the column left of the page that also holds the destinations.
